title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 1400 N Kraemer Blvd. in Placentia, California, as the "PFC Jang Ho Kim Post Office Building".
official_summary: This act designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 1400 N Kraemer Blvd. in Placentia, California, as the PFC Jang Ho Kim Post Office Building.

summary.headline: A law renames a Postal Service building in Placentia, California, after Private First Class Jang Ho Kim.
summary.what_it_does: This act officially names the United States Postal Service facility at 1400 N Kraemer Blvd. in Placentia, California, the PFC Jang Ho Kim Post Office Building. It changes only the name used for the building. It does not change postal services, mail rules, or staffing.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The act was enacted on December 27, 2022, and the designation took effect on that date.
